csv_scope_of_work: The purpose of this Request for Proposal ( RFP ) is to solicit landscape architectural services for the construction of the Athletics Recognition Garden. The intent of this project is to create a space on campus to recognize key individuals or groups that have impacted the Athletics department in a meaningful way. This garden will utilize a current lawn space with mature trees and convert it into a recognition garden that includes walkways (pavers & concrete), decorative curb, planting beds, accent lighting, site monuments and ties into the existing surroundings. This shall all take place while protecting the exiting mature trees.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Site Evaluation/Selection, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Electrical Engineering, Structural Engineering
